scenarios.label: Personal CSI
scenarios.title: Build self-directed learning without confusing practice gains with transfer
scenarios.recommendation: Use explicit self-regulated-learning routines, targeted cognitive practice when a bottleneck is identified, and a separate stress/attention-regulation component; measure transfer independently.

scenarios.label: Work CSI
scenarios.title: Adopt GenAI without quietly offloading the judgement you still need
scenarios.recommendation: Use scaffolded human-AI workflows with human-owned framing, evidence judgement and final decisions; preserve independent no-AI checkpoints and monitor hidden workload as well as speed.

scenarios.label: Health CSI
scenarios.title: Design cognitive support around functional goals, strategy use and maintenance
scenarios.recommendation: Prioritise goal-management and strategy-based rehabilitation linked to functional participation; treat computerised or telehealth delivery as delivery mechanisms and measure maintenance and everyday function separately from trained-task gains.
